items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: See, Contrell, he's a wonderful man on the clarinet.

ctx.x: What about the clarinet players now? Down here I'm talking about New Orleans. Yeah, I know, Shireen.

Well, they've got some good clarinet players. I like some, and they've got a lot of them that many fellas don't speak of. It's really wonderful. See, Contrell, he's a wonderful man on the clarinet. See, I don't hear much talk about him, but it's there. So they're great with me.
What about when you were first starting? Who were some of the great clarinet players down here?
